info.title: ClinicFlow — Mini Clinic Management System API
info.description: Proof-of-concept API. ABDM functionality runs against a MOCK adapter and does not perform real ABDM transactions. This software is not NABH- or ABDM-certified.

post.summary: Sign in with username and password; returns a bearer token
Sign out (revokes the current session)

get.summary: Current user, roles and effective permissions

post.summary: Change own password (revokes other sessions)

get.summary: Operational dashboard metrics (financial figures only with billing permissions)

post.summary: Create a user (must change password on first sign-in)

put.summary: Update user profile, roles or active status

post.summary: Reset a user's password (revokes their sessions)
Create a custom role

put.summary: Update role name/description and permission mapping

get.summary: Search audit log (filters: from, to, userId, action, entityType, entityId, patientId, outcome, page, size)
Verify the audit hash chain (tamper evidence)
Search patients by name, mobile, patient number or ABHA number/address (q, page, size)

post.summary: Register a patient. Returns 409 POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE with candidates unless confirmNotDuplicate + reason are given
Check for possible duplicate patients before registration

put.summary: Update demographics (optimistic locking via version; field changes recorded in history)

get.summary: Clinical history: consultations, diagnoses, medicines, orders, vitals (newest first)

post.summary: Record an allergy
Create a doctor profile linked to a user with the DOCTOR role

get.summary: Weekly working hours of a doctor

put.summary: Replace a doctor's weekly working hours and slot lengths

get.summary: Slot availability for a doctor on a date (date=YYYY-MM-DD, clinic timezone)
List appointments (filters: date, from, to, doctorId, patientId, status)

post.summary: Book an appointment in a free slot (double-booking is rejected with 409)
Register a walk-in: creates a checked-in visit and issues a queue token
Move a scheduled appointment to another free slot
Cancel an appointment (reason required)
Check a patient in for today's appointment and issue a queue token
Mark an appointment as no-show (after its start time)

get.summary: Waiting queue for a date (default today) and optional doctor

Skip a token (patient not present)
Start (or resume) the consultation for a checked-in appointment — treating doctor only

get.summary: Full consultation record with vitals, diagnoses, prescription, orders and addenda (audit-logged)

put.summary: Save draft consultation notes, vitals and diagnoses (version required)
Save draft prescription items, advice and investigation orders (CPOE)

Add a correction/addendum to a finalized consultation (original is never modified)
Add a medicine to the catalogue

put.summary: Edit or deactivate a catalogue medicine

get.summary: Search the investigation catalogue (LOINC-coded where available)

post.summary: Add a billable service

put.summary: Edit or deactivate a billable service

get.summary: List bills (date, status, patientId, q, page, size)

post.summary: Create a bill / invoice

get.summary: Get a bill with items and payments

post.summary: Record a (partial) payment
Record a refund (reason required in notes)
Cancel an unpaid bill (reason required)

get.summary: ABDM integration mode (mock) and supported consent parameters
ABHA identifiers linked to a patient (masked)

post.summary: Start ABHA linking: gateway sends an OTP to the patient (mock: no OTP is sent)
Confirm ABHA linking with the OTP (mock: 123456 succeeds, 999999 simulates timeout)
Unlink an ABHA identifier from the patient record
Raise a consent request (requires a verified ABHA link)
MOCK ONLY: simulate the patient granting or denying a consent request in their PHR app
Record withdrawal / revocation of consent
Share a finalized consultation as an FHIR document bundle against a granted consent (mock push)
Retry a failed consent request or health-information share
MOCK ONLY: make the next N gateway calls of an operation fail (for testing/demo)

get.summary: Export a record as FHIR R4 JSON. type: Patient | Practitioner | Organization | Appointment | Encounter | Invoice | Bundle (consultation document)
Local structural validation of the consultation FHIR bundle
